model.name: SprintOverviewGenerator.checkOverview
model.description: checkOverview(): assert the between-markers region == regenerated (drift -> FAIL named); the outside-markers region is NOT checked (hand-owned). Asserts the frozen-legacy set appears in output (VISIBLE, dropping one re-enters it). Missing overview file -> FAIL named, not skip-as-match (INV-C6-4). Folds into check:sprint-md / consistency:strict (R-C3). Idempotent (second run byte-stable). R-C6.
